_help: Launcher news. Edit this file on GitHub (main branch) and every launcher shows the change within a few minutes. Newest first by date. tag: Launcher, Network, Event, PVP, Update or Store. content is Markdown.

articles.title: The Portalbound Launcher is here
articles.author: Portalbound
articles.summary: One click, one portal – everything you need to play is already set up.
content: The launcher brings everything you need to play: the right Minecraft version, Java and the connection to **play.portalbound.xyz**.
- Sign in with your Microsoft account
- The play button unlocks by itself when the portal opens

articles.title: Release date is set
articles.author: Portalbound
articles.summary: The portal opens on January 1, 2027 at 1:00 PM (German time).
content: The portal opens on **January 1, 2027 at 1:00 PM** (German time). The countdown runs right here in the launcher and on the website.
Announcements, sneak peeks and events land on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/xvvq5WQPrm) first.

articles.title: The network is up
articles.author: Portalbound
articles.summary: Lobby and PVP run behind one proxy, ranks work everywhere.
content: Lobby and PVP run behind one shared proxy. Ranks apply on every server and you always join into the lobby.
